results.headline: AAOI posts record Q3 revenue and returns to GAAP profitability
results.summary: Applied Optoelectronics reported Q3 2026 revenue of $269.9 million on November 5, up 127.5% year over year and 40.6% sequentially, within its $255 million-$290 million outlook. GAAP net income was $6.3 million, or $0.07 per share, versus a $17.9 million loss a year earlier; non-GAAP EPS was $0.17, above the $0.14 consensus estimate.

results.headline: AAOI forecasts sharp Q4 growth but gross-margin guidance remains below prior-quarter expectations
results.summary: AAOI guided Q4 2026 revenue to $385 million-$420 million, implying approximately 200% year-over-year growth at the midpoint, with non-GAAP EPS of $0.48-$0.63 and gross margin of 29.5%-31%. Management expects $270 million-$300 million from datacenter products and $105 million-$115 million from CATV, while Q3 non-GAAP gross margin of 28.7% missed the 29%-30.5% target because of a higher mix of lower-margin 400G products.

results.headline: AAOI delays Phase 2 U.S. capacity expansion because of power and construction constraints
results.summary: Management said on November 5-6 that the Phase 2 U.S. expansion will be delayed by several months because obtaining electrical power is taking longer than expected, alongside other construction issues. The company now expects installed equipment for 800G and 1.6T products to support more than 500,000 units per month by year-end 2026, below the previously cited 650,000-unit target, with capacity expected to exceed 1 million units monthly by year-end 2027.

results.headline: AAOI faces materials constraints on 1.6T shipments despite approximately $450 million of orders
results.summary: During the Q3 call, CEO Thompson Lin estimated Q4 1.6T deliveries at approximately $50 million-$70 million, constrained by materials, despite roughly $450 million in orders. The company also cited supply bottlenecks for digital signal processors, contributing to Q4 revenue guidance that was reported as about 6% below consensus.
